repo_description: Official RevisionOS core recipes, modular extensions, homebrew games, apps, and previous release archive.
backbone_disclaimer: RevisionOS currently runs on the RevolaOS core and bootloader backbone. Folders and files on your iPod use /Revola/ names (such as /Revola/Firmware/revola.bin and /Revola/Extensions/) temporarily until upstream RepriseOS implements all required hooks and features.
custom_build_notice: Use the custom RevisionOS revola.bin firmware build rather than upstream RevolaOS or RepriseOS binaries. RevisionOS-specific core hooks are required by Hold Standby Clock, Silent Remote Volume, Car Audio, and Lyrics.

whats_new.title: Appearance 0.1.2
whats_new.summary: Verified resident stock artwork CRC before applying theme rules and kept restore slots armed on read errors so Dark Mode placeholder art never re-applies cracks.

whats_new.title: Hold Standby Clock 1.0.2
whats_new.summary: Fixed Now Playing volume slider staying stuck after Hold lock/unlock or inline remote volume changes, and used an instant standby clock transition over full-screen canvas views like Synced Lyrics.

whats_new.title: Car Audio 1.2.0
whats_new.summary: Handled iAP2 vendor EP0 0x53 reads, accepted short or unpadded HID Output reports and wValue low byte 0x00, logged vendor requests and LastBad HID diagnostics, and updated stereo compatibility notes.

whats_new.title: Lyrics 0.3.1
whats_new.summary: Fixed UTF-8/CP1252 diacritics decoding, stripped BOMs, normalized NFD accents, warmed Apple's runtime glyph cache across Latin/Cyrillic/CJK scripts, and added a live Synced/Unsynced title indicator.

whats_new.title: Silent Remote Volume 1.0.0
whats_new.summary: Prevents wired headphone inline and dock remote volume buttons from waking the screen or resetting the backlight timer.

whats_new.title: Extension categories
whats_new.summary: Every .rvx extension now encodes its category (Audio, Customization, Media, Utility, Connectivity, Developer) in RVMF.

extensions.name: Car Audio

extensions.description: Switch USB car protocol between iAP1 and iAP2 with 44.1 kHz digital audio, artwork, library sync, steering-wheel controls, connect play guard, and opt-in diagnostics logging. Tested and working on VAG MIB3 (Škoda Kodiaq); testing in progress on Stellantis UConnect, Honda, Alpine, Suzuki (Jimny 2026), and Mercedes-Benz (GLC 300 2019).
